extensionAttribute.description: Returns the Mac's firmware ABI width (EFI32 or EFI64). N/A on Apple Silicon, which boots iBoot rather than EFI.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # EFI Bits Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel only
if [[ "$(/usr/bin/uname -m)" == "arm64" ]]; then echo "<result>N/A</result>" exit 0 fi
bits=$(/usr/sbin/ioreg -l -p IODeviceTree 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk -F'"' '/firmware-abi/ { print $4; exit }')
echo "<result>${bits:-Unknown}</result>"
